messages:
mira_cs: Quick heads-up — AtlasNova signed up for a 2-week APAC pilot. They hit the per-minute throttle yesterday and asked for a temporary increase.

jordan_accounts: Noted. Renewal flagged as at-risk if pilot can't demonstrate stable latency. They want burst to 450 rps from their dev CIDR for 2 weeks.

mira_cs: @leo_net can we do IP allowlist + short-term rate window? Customer IPs: 203.0.113.0/27 and 198.51.100.128/28. Need TLS mTLS support but that's a follow-up.

leo_net: I can add the CIDRs to the edge ipset and open a rate window. Suggest adding an auto-revoke TTL of 14d. Any specific per-route caps?

mira_cs: Main traffic is /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings. Set per-route burst = 450 rps, global soft cap = 600 rps to allow short spikes. Please add header allowlist for their proxy x-client-id header: AtlasNova-Proof.

samuel_sre: @mira_cs tagging for SRE approval — increased per-route qps needs a quick risk check (cost & noisy neighbor). If they overload, we should fallback to small model variant.

jordan_accounts: They're on a month-to-month pilot — if we can show perf and cost stays reasonable, Renewal Q next quarter looks good. This is high priority for CS.

samuel_sre: Running quick capacity check... /assign me. Will need a short maintenance window if kernel-level ipset rules collide with current peering. ETA 45m.

enablement-bot: Incident check: No ongoing incidents in APAC. Recommended prewarming KV cache for AtlasNova's prefix to avoid cold-start latency.

leo_net: Drafting infra change:

```
# temp allowlist + rate window for AtlasNova (auto-revoke 14d)
ipset add atlasnova_203 203.0.113.0/27
ipset add atlasnova_198 198.51.100.128/28
route /v1/generate burst=450 per_route_soft=450 global_soft=600 headers.allow=x-client-id:AtlasNova-Proof
```

leo_net: I'll open a JIRA: INF-7382 and include the patch. Leaving note to ops to roll back after 2026-04-10 (auto-revoke).

mira_cs: Please capture AtlasNova feedback loop: they reported 300–400ms median in us-east but 800–1200ms in ap-northeast during spikes. Need region pin to ap-northeast-1.

samuel_sre: I can add routing policy: pin to ap-northeast-1 for their team token if they opt-in. That reduces cross-region latency but costs more. Will surface cost delta to @jordan_accounts.

jordan_accounts: Send cost delta to customer before enabling pin. Also capture in renewal notes that we helped mitigate pilot perf.

mira_cs: Customer asked for a quick enablement session Friday to validate model + prompts — i'll schedule with docs + runbook. Capture any quality regressions during increased qps.

leo_net: Change queued, will deploy after SRE signoff in ~45m. JIRA INF-7382. I added auto-revoke webhook to close the ipset after TTL.

samuel_sre: Change applied to staging and smoke tests passing. Rolling to prod in 5. Will monitor token-level latencies and open alert if p95 > 1500ms.

mira_cs: :thumbsup: please ping me when live so i can update AtlasNova. Also logging their feedback in the renewal tracker: "Pilot latency in APAC blocking conversion".

leo_net: Live. IPs allowed, rate window active, header match enforced. Watchlist created: atlasnova-3123459999.

mira_cs: Report back after 24h — we need customer sentiment captured and any quality regressions noted.

jordan_accounts: I'll add a renewal action item: Follow up w/ usage + cost summary on day 10.

mira_cs: Thanks team.
